node.statement: Uniform amplified Ha product defect: there are universal C_prod < infinity and e_prod > 0 such that every H-CB datum with e <= e_prod, every n >= 1, Z in M_n tensor S_{P,S}, and W in M_n tensor S_{S,R} satisfy ||(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z dot W)-(Ha^Q_{P,S})_n(Z)(Ha^Q_{S,R})_n(W)|| <= C_prod*e*||Z||||W||.
